answer: Ember-vine atlas sybil tax bond blocks clones. Each identity stakes 70 credits and pays an ember tax per epoch for one receipt on the vine ledger: first 30, the k-th 30+6(k-1), one key one receipt. The atlas checkpoint replays the ledger; unpaid, shared, or reused receipts burn the stake. Pooled payments fail: shared key trails burn together. 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 once, keeps its share.
